batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: st WP Saha b CH Gayle

batting.name: PD Collingwood
batting.dismissal: c DJ Hussey b CK Langeveldt

batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c A Mishra b R Bhatia

batting.name: Mandeep Singh
batting.dismissal: st KD Karthik b A Mishra

batting.name: DJ Hussey
batting.dismissal: c G Gambhir b UT Yadav

balls.text: Jadhav finishes in some style, clearing his front foot and biffing the ball straight back over Langeveldt's head for a one-bounce four
excellent bowling, in the blockhole, Warner digs it out to long off
yorker, played off the pads on the leg ide
well Hussey can't do it again, Warner hit the ball high over his head, clearing his front foot and swinging his bat hard

Hussey's pulled off a ripper! Collingwood hit it flat to the long-on boundary, Hussey was on the rope, he parried the ball over the boundary, then leapt back and while in the air hit the ball back into play, then he jumped back in and while in the air again grabbed the catch with one hand, he made sure he didn;t hit the ball too far back into play, that was the key, stunning effort
Warner gets to 100 and Delhi gives him a massive ovation, he reaches the landmark by driving to long off, second centurion of the tournament after Yusuf Pathan
pulled hard once again but this time to the fielder at deep backward square
Collingwood reaches a valuable half-century by clearing his front foot and lofting Gayle over his head for six, he's going for everything now
Warner wants two after playing off his pads to deep square, he gets only one and moves to 99
he goes over midwicket again but this time the ball falls short of the fielder
he's got under that and hammered it over deep midwicket with a lot of bottom hand. Collingwood stayed deep in his crease and cleared his front leg to make room
Gayle fires it in full, Collingwood digs it out but to the bowler
Collingwood moves back and hits the ball to deep cover for one
played to long off once again for one
driven off the front foot towards long off
Collingwood moves forward and pushes to cover
played to mid off for a single

stunning catch! Warner moves forward and chips the ball towards the bowler's left, Kartik dives full length and holds on to it with both hands, did that carry? Did he grass it? Warner seems happy it was taken and walks off, but hang on, the umpires are not convinced and ask for replays, the crowd cheer as Warner is asked to come back, that bounced as Kartik took it
played off the back foot to midwicket
Collingwood charges and pulls the ball behind square, not timed well though
driven to wide mid on for one
full toss and Collingwood pulls towards deep midwicket
Warner backs away and flat bats the ball down the ground
Gayle returns and Collingwood plays through midwicket for one
cut off the back foot through cover point
full ball and Warner hits a scorching shot towards long off where Hussey intercepts the ball
played off the back foot towards long on for a single
Collingwood takes two steps down, but isn't to the pitch of the ball and has to defend
Collingwood cuts off the back foot to cover
Warner goes back in his crease and hits the ball to long off with a flat bat
played to short third man on the back foot
full toss and Warner times the drive superbly through extra cover, Mathews dives on the boundary to save the four and has hurt himself, his lip is bleeding, think the ball hit his face
played to Mandeep again and again he fires in a good throw, Collingwood is too quick though
driven firmly towards point where Mandeep fields and fires the throw back in
Collingwood steps out to Hussey and hits him over midwicket
driven powerfully through cover for a single
in the blockhole outside off stump, Warner squeezes the ball towards point
Agarkar's bowled a high full toss and Warner's smashed him straight back over his head, the ball just clears Mandeep on the boundary
too short once again and Warner swats it flat over midwicket, lousy ball, he was going for that slower cutter
this time he connects with the pull but not very well
Collingwood tried to pull that on one knee but the ball was slower and he got beaten
Collingwood walks down the pitch, picks up the length early, and golf-swings the ball over midwicket, he hit that flat and powerfully
driven to long off for a single
Warner drives again, this time through point for one
driven down the ground for a single to long on
played back to the bowler, Hussey dives to his left and fields
Hussey delivers with a side arm action, like a spinning Malinga, Warner hits through cover
Collingwood plays off his pads to deep square leg
cut off the back foot to point
Collingwood mis-times the drive to cover, he had width to hit that
yorker, and Warner digs it out towards the off side
a full toss now and Warner hammers it down the ground, Tiwary sprints from long off and dives full length to save the four
fetch that! Warner swivelled and pulled the ball powerfully to the deep backward square leg boundary. What was the ball like? A long hop.
width offered again, this time Collngwood does not miss, cutting the ball towards third man
zippy ball outside off stump, Collingwood swishes, Collingwood misses
full and straight, Collingwood plays the ball to wide long-on for one
full outside off stump, Collingwood drives to the cover boundary where Gayle stops the ball deftly with his foot
cut to deep point for a single
Hussey angles the ball into Warner, pitches outside off stump, and spins the ball away at pace, Warner gets beaten
cut off the back foot to short third man for one more
driven down the ground to long-off for a single
pushed off the front foot towards cover
it spins again and hits the outside edge and goes towards backward point
Karthik rips the ball from middle stump across the bat of Collingwood, he was looking to punch it down the ground
Warner came down the track, was beaten by the flight, but adjusted in time to steer to short third man
defended back towards the bowler
short ball, a rank long hop and Warner rocks back and heaves it over the deep backward square leg boundary, almost the perfect ball to get after a break
good length on middle and off, pushed off the back foot towards long on
on leg stump and Warner works the ball off his pads to short fine leg
slower ball again and Collingwood checks his shot to play it straight past the bowler
Collingwood skips down the track, and uses a small back lift to chip the ball through midwicket for four
mis-cue, but safe! Warner was beaten by the slower ball and ended up lofting the ball tamely into no-man's land between mid-on and mid-off
played off the pads, he was cramped for room
a bit too wide this time and Warner cuts once again and keeps strike
Warner stays on the back foot, the ball spins into him and he cuts through point
Warner! He gets under a length ball and reached fifty by muscling the ball to the long-on boundary, it bounced a few inches short of the rope
Collingood takes a small step to the off and drives to long-off, single taken
played off the pads on the back foot for a single
he induces an outside edge from Warner to short third man
Warner pushes the final ball - good length on off - to cover
superbly timed cover drive from Collingwood but the fielder - Ganguly - dives to his right and makes a sharp save
slower ball outside off, Warner waits and cracks off the back foot to the man on the point boundary
nudged to midwicket for a rather risky single, a direct hit at the bowler's would have been close
the slower one outside off stump, driven to cover
good length ball on off stump, Collingwood stays firm in his crease and plays to mid-off
bowled full and wide outside off stump, Warner had made room and foun that he was too far away from the ball to play a shot
played towards point off the back foot
Warner's gone after him and cleared mid-on with a flat hit
he cramps Warner for room by going round the wicket, played on the off side
full toss and Collingwood chips it down the ground for a single
played off the pads towards mid-on where Kartik fumbles
pushed off the front foot towards cover
played off the pads towards long leg
another slower ball, fuller in length and Warner swings mightily at it, don't think he hit it 100% cleanly but it had enough to clear Ishant on the long-off boundary
slower ball on off stump, Warner mis-times the smash to cover
better length this time, and Warner drives along the ground to mid off
Langeveldt comes back and gives Warner a pie, a full toss outside off, Warner smashes it over mid-off
cracking shot Colly! Full outside off, he waits in his crease and drives through cover, precise placement
full toss, driven to long on for a single
pushed towards long on for one more
played off the pads towards square leg
played back to the bowler on the back foot
full ball outside off stump, Warner drives firmly to long off

bowled him! Karthik stays bent over his bat in dismay after poking tentatively at one outside off stump and inside-edging on to his stumps, that's the third time a wicket has fallen off the last ball of the over today
low full toss outside off stump, Warner reaches for it but connects with the bottom of his bat, gets a quick single to cover
this is a terrible over, Ishant sprays it wide again outside off stump
first six! Warner waits in his crease for the short ball to reach him and then plays a withering pull, sending the ball many many rows back over the midwicket boundary
short of a length outside off stump, Warner has enough room to slap the ball fiercely past the fielder at mid-off, he doesn't even bother chasing, Warner doesn't bother running
full outside off stump, a little too far outside off stump
Warner backs away towards leg stump, making room, gets under a length ball and lofts it cleanly over cover, the fielder gives chase but he isn't getting to that
good length ball on off stump, he swings it to midwicket on the front foot

lbw! Gambhir closed the face of the bat and missed an incoming delivery from Langeveldt, the ball hit him on the knee roll and that looked out, the umpire takes a while but eventually raises the finger
punched off the back foot firmly to mid-off, they run a single and Warner makes it easily, beating another direct hit
length ball and Warner muscles the ball to the wide long-on boundary
good length ball angling into off stump, Gambhir plays to point and sets off, Warner responds, Tiwary dives and hits direct from point but Warner is too quick
Langeveldt goes round the wicket and cramps him for room
short, wide and four! Warner winds up and slashes extremely hard at a lollypop from Langeveldt, the ball sails over the point boundary, oops it felt just short
Langeveldt runs in and delivers a wide ball outside off stump

gets him, sticks to his original strategy despite Sehwag's attack, got it right this time, full outside off and flat, Sehwag has made up his mind, charges down the wicket but it's a little wide of him, stretches to reach it, misses and Saha collects well behind the stumps, takes off the bails and sends back Sehwag
and more, loops up another full toss though his intention was to aim at the blockhole, comes down the track and thwacks him through the covers
full toss and Sehwag deals with it, on the off stump, he makes room and slaps it hard wide of extra cover for a boundary
hurling it on the pads, driven off the front foot wide of midwicket into the deep for a single
tossed it up on middle, played it with a straight bat back to the bowler
comes round the wicket and angles it towards middle, pushed off the front foot to extra cover
the off stump has been uprooted by a length ball that cut back into the right-hander and took the inside edge as well, well that's that! Delhi have walked all over Kolkata.

what happened there? McDonald bowled a yorker and Kartik had all sorts of trouble keeping it out, then he didn't know where the ball was and wandered down the pitch, Dinesh Karthik scampered in front of the stumps, picked up the ball and broke the stumps, Kartik's bat was in the air as the bails came off
struck powerfully towards long off
another single, to deep point
he backs away and drives to the fielder at cover
played on the leg side, five balls left in this mismatch

caught! Agarkar makes room and drives the ball back powerfully towards Collingwood's left, he takes it just above his head, he takes a tough catch so easily does Collingwood, minimum fuss maximum effect
length ball outside off stump, Agarkar cuts and threads the ball through the infield
played to deep midwicket once again
hit to deep midwicket for more insignificant runs
the batsman tries to slog sweep, doesn't connect

that's hit Nannes on his follow through, Saha smashed the ball back at the bowler and it struck the fingers on his left hand, Nannes screamed in pain and he is bleeding, a lot. He's gone off the field right away
Saha swings a full toss to deep midwicket but can't find the gap on the boundary
driven towards long on for another single, this will do wonders for Delhi's NRR
played to short third man for a measly single
nearly a yorker and Agarkar gets an inside edge on to his boot
he tries it again but the execution isn't as good, just the single this time
Saha winds up and pulls a gentle delivery from McDonald to the square leg boundary, can he hit three more of those?
Saha heaves mightily across the line but is no where close to making contact, this contest is fizzing out swiftly
Agarkar chips again, this time to long on
Saha swings across the line and mis-times to midwicket
he stays in his crease and chips the ball towards long off
Agarkar swings again and this time he doesn't place it between Karthik's legs, he misses it completely
Bhatia bowls a low ball outside off, Agarkar swings and gets a bottom edge through Karthik's legs for four
flicked off the pads through square leg
another full ball angling into the right hander, Saha tries to flick but gets hit on the pad
Agarkar tries to pull again but hits it limply towards midwicket
short ball and the batsman mis-times a pull to fine leg
he flicks a low full toss through square leg
Yadav comes back with a screaming yorker that's dead straight and beats Mathews completely, it hit middle stump after the batsman tried to make room
flicked and flicked more powerfully than I first thought, it beat the dive of the fielder on the square leg boundary
full ball on middle stump, driven back to the bowler
Mathews swings again and this time he mis-hits it over the head of Gambhir at mid-off
the fielder at mid-on is in the circle and Mathews gets under a full ball and clouts it over the infield, he cleared his front foot out of the way to create space to play the shot
full ball on the pads and the batsman fails to connect with the flick
good length an straight, dabbed to point for a single, have KKR given this up already?
full ball outside off, driven slowly to cover
low full toss on leg stump, flicked through square leg
driven through point for a single
Saha gets the first ball away to the fine leg boundary, he needs to pull off a miracle now
and that certainly won't do! Hussey has struggled for timing and this time he hits a full toss straight to Gambhir at midwicket
full and straight, driven to midwicket for another single, this won't do for Kolkata
the slower ball but it's wide outside off
full ball angling into the batsman, driven through cover
pushed towards mid off for a quick single
played to cover again, another dot ball
Mathews backs away towards leg and plays the ball to cover
played towards midwicket for one
he's hit this one! He got under a length ball, cleared his front foot out of the way, and hoisted it back over the bowler's head
Hussey lunges forward to play on the leg side but gets hit on the pad
Hussey hits a full toss straight to Collingwood at mid off and takes him on, risky run
driven hard to mid off for a quick single
short ball, too short and Mathews has enough time and space to pull powerfully off the front foot to the midwicket boundary
Hussey gets beaten again, but runs a bye to the keeper
fabulous bowling from Yadav, another searing yorker and Hussey spreads his legs to let it go between them
Hussey backs away and swings hard but only gets a bottom edge past his stumps
driven down the ground for a single
played off the back foot towards backward point
smashed back at the bowler, the ball crashes into the boot and deflects towards mid-off
too far down leg side this time, will have to rebowl that
Hussey backs away and plays the ball in front of point for a single
Hussey moves back and cuts the ball hard and late, placing it fine of the fielder at short third man
Mathews stays in his crease and cuts but cannot beat short third man
another yorker and Hussey can do nothing but play it back to the bolwer, terrific over Umesh
a yorker this time and Hussey barely manages to keep it out
Mathews backs away to make room and plays the ball to mid-off for a single
played through point for just a single, KKR need much much more now
a slower ball this time and Hussey defends back to the bowler
he strays down leg side this time, Hussey tries to leg glance but fails
... and he starts with a quick one, 138 kmh, and Hussey is late on the pull
spot on bowling on middle stump, Mathews defends on the front foot
driven off the back foot towards long off
tight line and length around off, Hussey cuts but can't beat point
defended on the back foot towards midwicket
he gets going with a push down the ground to long off
huge wicket! Gayle hits a length ball towards deep midwicket where Mishra runs to his left and holds a crucial catch on the move, is that effectively the end of the contest?
defended on the back foot towards the off side, just nine runs of Mishra's first three overs
Gayle goes right back and forces the ball to long on, Mishra's bowling an exceptional spell
played off the pads towards square leg
Gayle stays on the back foot and pushes the ball towards the off side, it's keeping a touch low
pushed off the back foot to point for a risky single, Gayle responds to Hussey's call and beats Sehwag's throw, it was a poor one from that distance, rather wide and Karthik had too much to do
played off the pads through square leg
Hussey tries to work the ball to the leg side once again but gets beaten? Did he nick that? Sounded like two noises. Karthik didn't collect.
Hussey nudges gently into the gap at midwicket and sprints for two
Gayle swings across the line and is too early on the shot, he gets hit on the pad by a full ball which pitched outside leg stump
played off the back foot through point for one
short and wide outside off stump, Hussey cuts hard and places it well enough to get four to the point boundary
played to square leg for a single
Gayle defends to the off side and then runs a quick single
pushed to cover off the front foot
played to point for a single
defended on the front foot
Dropped! Sehwag drops a steepler! Gayle swung hard at the ball and top-edged it high to square leg, Sehwag tried catching with the fingers pointing up and the ball burst through his fingers
massive appeal for lbw as the googly hits Hussey on the pad, not out says the umpire, that was close, it hit him on the knee roll
length again and Gayle drives powerfully over the fielder at mid-on, the camera could barely follow the ball, it was hit that hard
good comeback from Mcdonald, the yorker, Gayle digs it out
it looks effortless, Gayle simply waited for the length ball and sent it sailing over long-on, lots of bottom hand and several rows back
played off the back foot to short third man
bowled by the offcutter! It kept a touch low and beat Tiwary's defense, Kolkata's chase is in serious trouble but their best batsmen are yet to come
length ball around off stump, Gayle waits and whacks it to the fielder on the deep midwicket boundary
Tiwary strides forward and sweeps to the man at short fine leg
defended on the front foot towards the off side
Mandeep charges and swings, the ball dips and spins, it's the legbreak and it leaves Mandeep stranded, Karthik collects and flattens two stumps
Mandeep lunges forward and defends, plays the googly awkwardly
Mandeep gets down on one knee and sweeps, paddle sweeps rather
Gayle drives to long on for a single
good length on off stump, Mandeep defends on the off side off the front foot

bowled him! This time Ganguly moves a long way across his stumps and tries to flick, the leg stump is exposed and Nannes flattens it with a full and fast delivery, Ganguly was struggling against Nannes and now it's over
again he backs away and Nannes gives him length, Ganguly cuts but can't beat the infield at point
this time he backs away and hits a length ball past the bowler for four, Ganguly moves to five off eight balls
a fiery yorker outside off stump and Ganguly is late in bringing his bat down in time, luckily for him it wasn't straight
Ganguly backs away to make room but Nannes follows him with a short of a length ball, he ends up swishing and missing
he hit this with the middle, heaving it over the deep square leg boundary, first six of the innings
this time Gayle connects with the flick, hitting it with the inside half of the bat and placing it between square leg and short fine leg
Gayle misses the flick and gets hit on the pad, McDonald appeals but that pitched outside leg stump
that's extremely wide down leg side, Karthik stops it with his pads
full ball and Ganguly drives to wide long off, there's a fielder in the deep
good length on off stump, Ganguly opens the face and steers the ball to point
full ball and Gayle forces it to midwicket
fuller length ball outside off stump, driven to point
full ball on off stump, Ganguly defends towards cover
Ganguly jumps inside the line of a delivery on his hips and it gets called wide down leg side
Ganguly gets caught on the crease by Nannes' angle into the left-hander, he defends awkwardly
played off the pads to square leg for a single
that looked slower but the speed gun said it was 137 kmh, Gayle once again let it go outside off stump
super ball first up, short of a length and rising, Gayle moves across his stumps and pulls his bat away from the line of the ball
